notes.title: V 1.1.2
notes.content:
- Resources such as wood, ores and rocks now give more per hit and more loot per item. 

- Melee weapons attack damage has been adjusted for the Rusty pickaxe, Pickaxe, Quartzite Axe, Lumberjack Axe,
  Knife, Stone Mace, Jawbone Mace and Machete.

- Some sounds have been ajusted.

- From now when going underwater you have 120 secondes before an exclamation mark apear and do 12 damage points every time it tick. 
  If your health reaches 0 your player dies and you lose all your inventory.

- Values of all 9mm bullets damage has been upgraded.

notes.title: V1.1.1
notes.content:
Main feature in this update is 7 new craftable pieces of furniture that can be upgraded to enhance your home or environment. For a total of 21 new furniture.
- Time of day is now 45 min day, 15 min night.
- The fuel time of the lamp oil has been upgraded to 160 secondes per unit, means the oil lamp will give a continuous light for about 2 days 2/3 in game time if not turn off.
- Cloth as resource can now be crafted.
- A few minor changes has been made to the landscape.

notes.title: V1.1.0
notes.content:
-I've added in this update 11 craftable pieces of furnitures that can be upgraded to enhance your home or environment,
- Some minor changes has been made to the landscape.

notes.title: Mini Update V1.0.6
notes.content:
- 5 human camps has been added
- I changed the material of the stone buildparts
- Minor changes has been done on the map
- The deer health has been lowered
- The tribe Shooters chances of hit has been lowered
- Some inventory items are now stackable in the inventory
- Some inventory items now use less space in the backpack

notes.title: V1.0.5
notes.content:
- A compass has been added to the screen.
- I added Laser beams to be crafted wich will help you to find locations such as your camps, water sources or to locate a specific place on the isle. They can be seen From about everywhere. They can be found in the cache ammo crates.
- A few minor changes has been made on the terrain.

notes.title: V1.0.4
notes.content:
- Player will always start with a backpack. All backpacks that are in the game that you can equip with will 
   be removed in a next update. If you keep loots in them they will be lost.
- Explosive combat dogs now damage the player.
- The amount of resources needed to craft some items and buildparts has been lowered.
- I fixed some clipping issues with animal attacks. Please report if you have any issues with clipping while 
   in being attacked.
- I have replied the disapearing backpack issue in the editor and fixed what I guessed it was. If you 
   experience it again please let me know.

notes.title: Update V.1.0.3
notes.content:
- Dominant tribe Shooters are now in. Some provide a shotgun to use with buckshots.
- I've adjust some mesh LODs for better performance.
- I have worked on the actor spawning system so they don't spawn on shack roofs,  boats and structures.
- I fixed some sounds.
- Guns now have to be equiped to be used.

notes.title: Mini Update
notes.content:
- I've increase the light range of the basic campfire.
- Now there is a total of 10 fresh water ponds on the map.
- The game will now start at sunrise. 
- The basic saw bench now have 5 convert slots.
- A new oil lamp has been added to the game. 
  Turn animal fat into fuel for the oil lamp using the campfire.
- A few things has been done on the land.
- Tribe man dead body despawn time is now set to 180 seconds.
- Combat dogs can now be looted. They provide buckshot ammo and gun powder.
  They might explode when hit.

notes.title: Mini Update
notes.content:
- I changed the amount of cooking slots from 1 to 4 in the basic campfire.
- You can now use empty bottle to collect clean water from ponds. 
- Animal rawmeat, fat, cooked meat and smoked meat are now stackable (3).
- Bear health has been lowered from 1000 to 600.
- Deer health has been lowered from 350 to 300.
- You can now make 15 planks at a time in the Basic Saw Banch.
- Planks and beams size in the inventory has been reduced to 1 x 3 slots.
- I reduced the amount of resources needed to craft benches and change the size and weight in the 
   player inventory.
- Changed a few things in the benches UI.
- And a few more things.
